versions.changelog:
- Now fetches curated AI news, social signals, blogs, papers, events, and skills from Agentic Brew public RSS feeds.
- Added support for 11 feeds spanning news, social platforms (Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, Product Hunt, GitHub), blogs, papers, events, and top AI skills.
- Provides an interactive flow for vague requests: guides users to choose categories, delivery frequency (once, daily, weekly), and preferred detail level (headline, summary, detailed).
- Direct command usage allows specifying feed, result limit, keyword filter, and output format (markdown or JSON).
- Uses efficient, no-auth RSS fetching—no scraping required.
